experiment: sw075 census conduct re-read (spec: /workspace/Neel Sprint/experiments/sprint_work/075_census_conduct_reread/design_spec.md; decisions: DECISIONS.md there)
census_turns.jsonl: one row per census context (5,480 = 274 roles x 20 scripts). key = sw075|census|<role>|<script_id>; role; script_id; system (the role prompt); user1, asst1, user2, asst2 (the parent's own turns 1-2, decoded from token ids); user3 (trigger turn with prohibition); bridge ('Fun fact about the'); n_tok_asst1/2 (Qwen tokens); src_id (row id in the sw001 job file and in the routing log-odds rows).
census_decode_check.json: decode checks C1-C4 (round trip, rebuild, id sets vs routing rows and R files, text vs sw001 saved histories); failures {} = all pass.
census_judged.jsonl: judge records (lib judge_run.py, custom rubric = src/conduct5_template.txt). One line per (key, judge); judge in {glm, deepseek}. <field>_w = logprob-weighted 0-10 score (THE score used), <field> = the integer the judge wrote, <field>_mass = probability mass on valid integers; fields hostility, declining, helpfulness, warmth, register (0 = very formal, 10 = very casual). Valid = error null and every _w present; last valid line per (key, judge) wins. The judge saw user1, asst1, user2, asst2 only.
census_half10_in.jsonl / census_half10_s: Phase-2 option B input: the same 10 topic-stratified scripts for every role (2,740 contexts).
census_pilot20_in.jsonl: 20 seeded-random contexts judged in Phase 1 for the cost measurement (reused by the main run).
ka/: known-answer gate: ka_in.jsonl (20 contexts), ka_bands.json (expected bands L<=3, H>=7, M 2-8), ka_judged.jsonl, ka_result.json (gate PASS + per-item scores [consensus, glm, deepseek, band]).
rule_reach_sim.json: simulation: probability the frozen rule says 'own conduct explains' when conduct is the whole cause, by conduct-measure validity rho_m (src/rule_reach_sim.py).
analysis/: Phase 2: results.json (every model, CI, rule, sensitivities, reliability, judge agreement, calibrated null) and role_table.json (per role: R_hd, R_hs pooled = 1/2 (R_raw_A + R_raw_B), P1, P4_disp, P4_tone, P5, the 5 conduct means, n_contexts). src/analyze.py. samples10.json = the 10 seeded-random contexts (src/samples.py, random.Random(7575) over the sorted judged keys of the 271 roles) with full turns, both judges' scores and notes.
fake_test/: analysis code tests on fake judge records (exact, explains, persona, mixed).
judge_full.log: stdout of the full judge_run (progress, spend, DONE 10960/10960).
census_judged.jsonl.first250_DONE / .pil: markers of the two earlier partial stages (renamed so they cannot be read as the full batch); census_judged.jsonl.DONE = the full 5,480-key manifest complete.
recompute_definitions: population: predictors.json census roles with animal_role False (271). Pooled R per pair = 1/2 (R_raw_A + R_raw_B) from R_hd_rtx.json (A_s0, B_s0) and R_hs.json (hs_A, hs_B) in experiments/sprint_work/003_routing_features_and_pirate_family/src/C/. Role conduct = mean over the role's 20 contexts of the mean of the GLM and DeepSeek <field>_w. Models: OLS + intercept on z-scored predictors; LOO CV R^2 = 1 - PRESS/SST. Partial = Spearman of the residuals of rank(R) and rank(P1) after OLS on the ranks of the 5 conduct fields + intercept. 2,000 role-bootstrap percentile CIs.
